basics.description:
**Cloud Health Office** - The #1 source-available Azure-native multi-payer EDI platform.

Deploy a complete HIPAA-compliant EDI integration solution in minutes. This managed application includes:

- ✅ X12 EDI Processing (275, 277, 278, 837)
- ✅ FHIR R4 Integration (CMS-0057-F Compliant)
- ✅ Prior Authorization APIs
- ✅ Zero-Code Payer Onboarding
- ✅ Enterprise Security (HSM-backed keys)

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Select the Azure region for deployment.

basics.name: baseName
basics.label: Deployment Name
basics.toolTip: Base name for all resources (3-20 characters, alphanumeric). Example: 'myhealthplan'

basics.name: organizationName
basics.label: Organization Name
basics.toolTip: Your organization name for branding and compliance documentation.

basics.name: adminEmail
basics.label: Administrator Email
basics.toolTip: Email address for notifications and alerts.

validations.message: Please enter a valid email address.

options.text: Select a deployment tier based on your organization's needs. All tiers include full platform functionality - tiers differ in performance, redundancy, and compliance features.

elements.name: tier
elements.label: Deployment Tier
elements.toolTip: Select the deployment tier that matches your requirements.

allowedValues.label: Sandbox (Development/Testing)
allowedValues.description: Ideal for development and testing. Lower costs, reduced redundancy.

allowedValues.label: Standard (Production)
allowedValues.description: Recommended for production. Geo-redundant storage, 365-day log retention.

allowedValues.label: Enterprise (High Availability)
allowedValues.description: Maximum availability and security. Zone redundancy, HSM-backed keys.

options.text:
**Sandbox**: WS1 Logic App, Free Integration Account, Standard_LRS Storage, 30-day logs

**Standard**: WS2 Logic App, Basic Integration Account, Standard_GRS Storage, 365-day logs

**Enterprise**: WS3 Logic App, Standard Integration Account, Standard_RAGRS Storage, 365-day logs, Zone Redundancy, Premium Key Vault (HSM)
Enable or disable platform features. All features are recommended for full CMS-0057-F compliance.

elements.name: enableB2B
elements.label: Enable X12 B2B Integration Account
elements.toolTip: Required for HIPAA X12 EDI transaction processing (275, 277, 278, 837).

elements.name: enableFhirIntegration
elements.label: Enable FHIR R4 Integration
elements.toolTip: Enable FHIR R4 APIs for CMS-0057-F compliance (Patient Access, Provider Access, Payer-to-Payer).

elements.name: enableCosmosDb
elements.label: Enable Cosmos DB
elements.toolTip: Required for Prior Authorization and Provider Directory APIs.

options.text: Configure SFTP connectivity for EDI file exchange. Leave blank for sandbox mode - credentials can be configured post-deployment.

validations.message: Enter a valid hostname or leave blank.

elements.name: sftpPassword
elements.toolTip: SFTP password for authentication. Will be stored securely in Key Vault.

options.text:
Review your configuration before deployment. The managed application will deploy the following resources:

- Logic App Standard (Workflow Runtime)
- Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2
- Service Bus Namespace with Topics
- Application Insights & Log Analytics
- Key Vault for Secrets Management
- Integration Account (if B2B enabled)
- Cosmos DB (if enabled)

By deploying this application, you agree to the [Privacy Policy](https://cloudhealthoffice.com/privacy), [Service Level Agreement](https://cloudhealthoffice.com/sla), and [Support Terms](https://cloudhealthoffice.com/support). This application processes Protected Health Information (PHI) and requires appropriate Business Associate Agreements.
